description: This file defines the ConstantFuture class, which implements the Future interface to represent a future holding a constant value that is always considered complete and non-cancelable.

classes.name: ConstantFuture
classes.description: A generic class implementing Future that always returns a fixed value and is always considered done.

methods.name: ConstantFuture
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ConstantFuture with a given value.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Always returns false, as cancellation is not supported.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the stored value, indicating the Future is complete.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the stored value, ignoring timeout parameters.

methods.name: isCancelled
methods.description: Always returns false, indicating the task cannot be canceled.

methods.name: isDone
methods.description: Always returns true, indicating the future is complete.
